item.title: Trump stops short of saying Iran violated ceasefire: 'not heavy firing'
item.description: Trump told ABC News Iran "better hope" the ceasefire holds.

item.title: Sen. Reed on Trump’s Iran strategy: ‘I don’t believe the president has a plan’
item.description: Ranking Senate Armed Services Committee Democrat Jack Reed said he believes the U.S. is in a "much worse position" with Iran since the war started.
